marketing.headline1: Fill the unified NIS2 supplier questionnaire once.
marketing.intro: Structured to ENISA NIS2 Technical Implementation Guidance v1.0 (June 2025). Every question maps to a specific paragraph of CIR 2024/2690, BSIG §30, or BSI IT-Grundschutz. One questionnaire. One standard. Your data stays portable — no lock-in, exportable as JSON anytime.
marketing.anchorBadge: Structured to ENISA NIS2 Technical Implementation Guidance v1.0 (June 2025) §5
marketing.bsiQuote: Wir begrüßen aktuelle Vorstöße der Wirtschaft, einen einheitlichen Fragenkatalog für Lieferanten zu erarbeiten.
marketing.bsiAttribution: — BSI NIS-2 FAQ (Lieferketten und Sicherheit). The supplier portal is that initiative — a private-sector unified questionnaire structured to the canonical EU taxonomy (ENISA TIG §5) so every NIS2-regulated entity can satisfy CIR §5.1.4 with a single source.
marketing.benefit1Body: Answer the BSI / CIR questions once. Every customer you invite sees the same vetted answers — no more bespoke security questionnaires per relationship.
marketing.benefit2Body: Every section header and field cites a specific paragraph of ENISA's NIS2 Technical Implementation Guidance (June 2025) plus the underlying CIR 2024/2690 article. Auditors recognise the taxonomy. Customers trust the structure. No invented categories.
marketing.benefit3Body: When an asset you manage has a security incident, you notify the affected customer with one click. Each customer sees only their own assets and their own notifications. They satisfy their NIS2 §30 supplier monitoring obligation by reading your update.
marketing.benefit4Title: Bilateral and private. No public profile.
marketing.benefit4Body: Built in Germany, hosted in the EU, aligned with BSI Grundschutz defaults. Your data is shared only with the customers you explicitly invite — no public URL, no search engine indexing. Customers access via a private magic link with no platform account required.
marketing.footerBody: Sign in with Google. Fill in your company name and primary domain. Answer the questionnaire at your own pace. Invite your customers when you are ready.

questionnaire.title: BSI / CIR Supplier Questionnaire
questionnaire.intro: Every question maps to a specific paragraph of CIR 2024/2690 — the binding EU regulation under NIS2 — or to BSI IT-Grundschutz. Fill it once; every customer who subscribes sees the same answers.
questionnaire.saveError: Could not save — please try again.
questionnaire.submitError: Could not sign off — fix the validation errors first.

fields.dataProcessingLocations: Countries / regions where customer data is processed
fields.bsiRegistrationId: BSI registration ID (only if your company is itself NIS2-regulated)
fields.hasIso27001OrEquivalent: Hold ISO 27001, BSI Grundschutz, or equivalent certification
fields.staffSecurityTraining: Annual security awareness training for all staff
fields.backgroundChecks: Background checks on staff with customer data access
fields.vulnerabilityHandling: Documented vulnerability handling and patching process
fields.acceptRightToAudit: Accept customer right to audit (or provide audit reports)
fields.dataReturnOnTermination: Commit to return / destroy customer data on termination
fields.securityPolicyReviewedAnnually: Security policies reviewed at least annually
fields.hasBusinessContinuityPlan: Documented business continuity / disaster recovery plan
fields.hasPrivilegedAccessMgmt: Privileged access management (PAM) for internal staff
fields.mfaEnforcedInternal: MFA enforced for all internal admin / privileged accounts
fields.hasAssetInventory: Maintain an inventory of information assets
fields.hasPenetrationTestingProgram: Annual or biennial penetration testing program
fields.pastBreachesDisclosed: We disclose past notifiable cybersecurity events when asked by customers
fields.incidentAssistanceCommitment: Provide incident assistance to customers at no / ex-ante cost
fields.cooperateWithAuthorities: Fully cooperate with competent authorities (BSI, ENISA, national CSIRTs)
fields.notifyMaterialChanges: Notify customers of any material change affecting service delivery
fields.notifyOnLocationChange: Notify customers in advance if data-processing locations change
fields.hasExitPlan: Documented exit strategy with mandatory transition period
fields.saasMfaEnforced: MFA enforced for all admin accounts
fields.onPremSbomProvided: Provide a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)
fields.proServicesNdaInPlace: NDA in place with all consultants

fieldDescriptions.legalName: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.2(a) — supplier register entry.
fieldDescriptions.registeredAddress: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.2(a) — supplier register entry.
fieldDescriptions.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE, FR, IT.
fieldDescriptions.securityContactName: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.4(d) — incident notification chain.
fieldDescriptions.serviceDescription: Required by ENISA TIG §5.2(b) + §5.1.4 TIPS — clear and complete description of the ICT products and services you provide. One paragraph.
fieldDescriptions.dataProcessingLocations: Required by ENISA TIG §5.1.4 TIPS — list every country / region where your customers' data is produced, processed or stored. Comma-separated.
fieldDescriptions.bsiRegistrationId: Optional. ENISA TIG §5.1.2 — if your company is itself a NIS2-regulated entity with a BSI registration, your customers can use this fact to satisfy their §5.1.2 supplier-selection criteria.
fieldDescriptions.isSaas: Determines which technical questions you'll see next. Pick all that apply.
fieldDescriptions.isOnPrem: Software your customers install on their own hardware.
fieldDescriptions.isManagedService: Operating the customer's IT under contract (MSP, MSSP).
fieldDescriptions.hasIsms: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.2(a) — cybersecurity practices of suppliers.
fieldDescriptions.hasIso27001OrEquivalent: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.2(b). Upload the certificate via the Certifications tab.
fieldDescriptions.staffSecurityTraining: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.4(b) — awareness, skills and training.
fieldDescriptions.backgroundChecks: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.4(c) — verification of staff background.
fieldDescriptions.vulnerabilityHandling: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.4(f) — handle vulnerabilities that present a risk.
fieldDescriptions.acceptRightToAudit: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.4(e) — right to audit or to receive audit reports.
fieldDescriptions.subprocessorList: List the subprocessors and what they do for you. CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.4(g).
fieldDescriptions.dataReturnOnTermination: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.4(h) — retrieval and disposal of information at termination.
fieldDescriptions.dpaAvailable: GDPR Art. 28 — written data processing agreement.
fieldDescriptions.securityPolicyReviewedAnnually: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.1(c) — security policies must be reviewed and updated regularly.
fieldDescriptions.hasIncidentResponsePlan: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.3 / NIS2 Art. 21(2)(b) — documented incident handling procedures.
fieldDescriptions.hasBusinessContinuityPlan: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.5 / NIS2 Art. 21(2)(c) — business continuity and crisis management.
fieldDescriptions.hasCryptographyPolicy: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.6 / NIS2 Art. 21(2)(h) — policies and procedures regarding the use of cryptography.
fieldDescriptions.hasPrivilegedAccessMgmt: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.7 / NIS2 Art. 21(2)(i) — access control policies for privileged accounts.
fieldDescriptions.mfaEnforcedInternal: Required by NIS2 Art. 21(2)(j) — multi-factor authentication for accounts with elevated privileges.
fieldDescriptions.hasAssetInventory: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.8 / NIS2 Art. 21(2)(i) — asset management.
fieldDescriptions.hasPenetrationTestingProgram: Required by CIR 2024/2690 §5.1.12 — testing of cybersecurity risk-management measures.
fieldDescriptions.pastBreachesDisclosed: ENISA TIG §5.1.2 — selection criteria require entities to consider 'the supplier's history in relation to cybersecurity events and breaches'.
fieldDescriptions.incidentAssistanceCommitment: ENISA TIG §5.1.4 TIPS — supplier obligation to assist the customer at no / ex-ante cost during a cyber incident caused by the ICT product or service.
fieldDescriptions.cooperateWithAuthorities: ENISA TIG §5.1.4 TIPS — supplier obligation to fully cooperate with competent authorities during inspections, audits and incident handling.
fieldDescriptions.notifyMaterialChanges: ENISA TIG §5.1.4 TIPS — notification of any development that might have a material impact on the supplier's ability to effectively provide the ICT products or services.
fieldDescriptions.notifyOnLocationChange: ENISA TIG §5.1.4 TIPS — notify the customer in advance if data-processing locations envisaged to change.
fieldDescriptions.hasExitPlan: ENISA TIG §5.1.4 TIPS — exit strategy with a mandatory adequate transition period, IP provisions and supplier responsibilities during the exit period.
fieldDescriptions.saasHostingRegion: BSI IT-Grundschutz OPS.2.2 Cloud-Nutzung — where customer data is stored.
fieldDescriptions.saasEncryptionAtRest: BSI IT-Grundschutz OPS.2.2.A11. AES-256 or equivalent.
fieldDescriptions.saasEncryptionInTransit: BSI IT-Grundschutz OPS.2.2.A11. TLS 1.2 minimum, TLS 1.3 preferred.
fieldDescriptions.saasMfaEnforced: BSI IT-Grundschutz ORP.4.A23 — second-factor authentication for privileged accounts.
fieldDescriptions.saasRtoHours: BSI IT-Grundschutz DER.4 — maximum tolerated downtime for customer service.
fieldDescriptions.onPremSbomProvided: CRA / NIS2 supply-chain transparency. Format: CycloneDX or SPDX.
fieldDescriptions.onPremSignedReleases: BSI IT-Grundschutz CON.8 Software-Entwicklung — signed releases prevent supply-chain tampering.
fieldDescriptions.onPremVulnerabilityDisclosurePolicy: BSI IT-Grundschutz CON.10. Public security.txt or contact for vulnerability reports.
fieldDescriptions.onPremPatchSlaCriticalHours: Time from CVE disclosure to patch availability for critical vulnerabilities.
fieldDescriptions.proServicesBackgroundCheckScope: BSI IT-Grundschutz ORP.2.A14 — staff vetting for sensitive roles.
fieldDescriptions.proServicesNdaInPlace: BSI IT-Grundschutz ORP.2.A2 — confidentiality agreements with all consultants.
fieldDescriptions.proServicesCustomerPremisesPolicy: BSI IT-Grundschutz ORP.3.A4 — security awareness on customer premises.
fieldDescriptions.managedPrivilegedAccessMgmt: BSI IT-Grundschutz ORP.4.A26 — PAM for administrative remote access.
fieldDescriptions.managedSessionRecording: BSI IT-Grundschutz OPS.1.2.5.A11 — recorded remote maintenance sessions.
fieldDescriptions.managedOnCall24x7: BSI IT-Grundschutz DER.2.1 — incident detection and response coverage.
